dish.title: Moroccan Chermoula Fish Tagine with Potatoes, Peppers, and Olives

recipe_version.title: Moroccan Chermoula Fish Tagine with Potatoes, Peppers, and Olives
recipe_version.description: Cod marinated in chermoula (cilantro, parsley, garlic, cumin, paprika, and lemon) and braised on a bed of thin-sliced potatoes, red peppers, and tomatoes with green olives and preserved lemon. Served with crusty bread for the juices.

steps.title: Make the chermoula and prep
steps.body: Stir the cilantro, parsley, garlic, cumin, paprika, lemon juice, 3 tbsp olive oil, and 1/2 tsp salt together. Rub a third of it over the fish and refrigerate. Slice the potatoes 1/4 inch thick, cut the pepper into strips and the tomatoes into wedges, slice the preserved lemon rind, and cut the second lemon into wedges.

steps.title: Braise the vegetables
steps.body: Toss the potatoes with half the remaining chermoula and 1 tsp salt. Film a 12-inch skillet (or stovetop tagine) with 2 tbsp olive oil, layer in the potatoes, and top with the peppers and tomatoes. Pour in 3/4 cup water, bring to a simmer over medium-high, cover, and cook over medium-low until the potatoes are tender, about 20 minutes.

steps.title: Add the fish
steps.body: Lay the fish on the vegetables, spoon the rest of the chermoula over it, and scatter the olives and preserved lemon. Cover and simmer until the fish is opaque, flakes, and reads 145 F, about 10 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Serve from the pan with lemon wedges and the bread for the juices.

equipment: 12-inch skillet with lid or stovetop tagine

near_duplicate_review: Compared with moroccan-seven-vegetable-couscous: fish over sliced potatoes, no couscous or broth. Compared with lebanese-samke-harra-bulgur: herb chermoula braise, no tahini, no bulgur. Compared with senegalese-fish-yassa: herb-spice chermoula over potatoes, not a mustard-lemon onion sauce. Compared with red-snapper-veracruzana in this wave: potato bed, cumin-herb chermoula, preserved lemon; not a tomato-sauce simmer with jalapeños. Compared with deep-fried-cod-roasted-potatoes: braised, not battered.
not_duplicate_of: Not chicken tagine with preserved lemon (poultry load; Moroccan would be a third poultry-free gap left open).
